'''Lorwin Derlynn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Derlynn was a career officer in the Thaereian military. During the Clone Wars, he believed that the [[Cularin Militia]] might be a front for a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] cell, so he lead a squad of Thaereian troops to investigated an [[Cularin Militia asteroid base|abandoned Militia base]] in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] arrived at the base while Detlynn was there and he he tried to get them to surrender. The heroes tried to persuade him and the squad that the Thaereians were evil and that they should defect to the Militia.

==Personality and traits==
Derlynn would think before shooting and preferred to take prisoners than to kill people. He believed that the Cularin Militia were ruthless scum, because his superiors had led them to believe that.

==Behind the scenes==
Derlynn made his first and only appearance in ''[[Belted In: Incursion|Incursion]]'', a scenario in the [[Belted In trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign, a supplement to the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]. In that his rank during his encounter with the heroes depends upon what tier level the player characters are at: for lower tier players he is a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]], for mid-tier ones he is a [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] and for higher tier players, he is a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]].
